meta.purpose: Reference query set to measure ranking/behavior changes from Lot B (roadmap b27f5663 trigram prefilter for contains mode, roadmap 10096483 multi-term IDF ranking) against a real, already-indexed codebase (this repo) instead of a synthetic fixture.
meta.corpus: This repo (AiDex) at the pinned commit above. The harness reconstructs that exact tree via `git archive <pinnedCommit>` into a fresh temp dir at test time, so ground truth never drifts under concurrent edits to the live working tree.

groundTruthMethod.identifier: ripgrep whole-word count (-w -F), case-sensitive, over src/tests/hooks restricted to *.ts/*.tsx/*.js, node_modules and build excluded.
groundTruthMethod.multiword: ripgrep exact-phrase count (-F), case-sensitive, same file scope. Ground truth is presence of the literal string in source; the point of this family is that aidex_query cannot express it at all today (see note per entry).
groundTruthMethod.contains: ripgrep case-insensitive substring count (-i -F), same file scope. This counts raw text occurrences per line and will NOT equal AiDex's own occurrence count (AiDex dedups by item+line and excludes comment-only / non-syntax-node text) -- that gap is expected and is reported by the harness, not hidden.

meta.note_on_family_multiword: Confirmed by reading src/coverage/rule.ts (classifyPattern, MIN_LEN/MAX_LEN + `/\s/.test(p)` reject) and src/parser/extractor.ts (literalText(node) is the WHOLE string node text, checked once against literalQualifies before being stored as a single item): a string literal containing whitespace is REJECTED AT INDEX TIME. It is not merely unreachable through the single-term aidex_query call, it is never written to the items table at all. This is stronger than the roadmap card's framing ('aidex_query only takes one term') and worth flagging back explicitly.
